request.style: English, foot-stomping traditional gospel, strong male lead vocal with call-and-response gospel choir, Hammond organ, piano, bass, drums, hand claps, rising and jubilant, 116 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The hand of the LORD came down on me and set me in a valley wide
And it was full of bones, very many, very dry
He led me all around them and he asked me can they rise
Son of man, can these bones live
O Lord GOD, you know

[Chorus]
Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD
I am going to put breath in you, and you will live
Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD
And you will know that I am the LORD

[Verse]
So I prophesied as I was commanded
And there was a sound, a rattling
And the bones came together, bone to bone
Sinews on them, flesh had grown, and skin had covered them over
But there was no breath in them

[Chorus]
Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD
I am going to put breath in you, and you will live
Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD
And you will know that I am the LORD

[Bridge]
Come from the four winds, O breath
And breathe into these slain, that they may live
The breath came into them
They came to life and stood on their feet
Our bones are dried up, our hope is gone
I am going to open your graves
I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live

[Chorus]
Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD
I am going to put breath in you, and you will live
Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD
And you will know that I am the LORD
